answer.value: Only partially stated. Synthetic data: multimodal "Thinking" reasoning data built by having InternVL3-78B describe images and DeepSeek-R1 sample reasoning rollouts, with incorrect rollouts filtered out. Pre-training uses "large-scale text and multimodal corpora", with no provenance given. The card gives no breakdown into web crawl, licensed, or user data.
quotes: To construct such data, we first use InternVL3-78B to describe the image and then input the description into DeepSeek-R1 to sample rollouts with detailed reasoning processes.
During the pre-training stage, we update all model parameters jointly using the combination of large-scale text and multimodal corpora.
